d:
Zoya hasan ke anusar, SIR aur matdata suchi men badlav ko lekar barhta virodh ab vot ke adhikar aur chunavi nishpakshata ki bari bahas ban gaya hai. jantar-mantar se ‘dilli chalo’ tak hue pradarshanon ne loktantrik adhikaron, chunav aayog ki nishpakshata aur sansthagat javabdehi se jure kaee saval khare kie hain.
Thank you for watching our video!
